title: MMO Realms - Cobblemon
description: The #1 Cobblemon Server for Minecraft. Our server is the one stop for Pokemon in Minecraft
body:
# 🌍 Welcome to MMO Realms 🌍

## MMO Realms is a next level Cobblemon experience built around progression, exploration, and true player freedom.

Explore the frequently **refreshing Wilds**, packed with loot, resources, and adventure that never runs dry. Take on **Region Based Gyms** inspired by Kanto and other main series regions, earn badges, and prove yourself as a top trainer. 

Then return to what makes us different to other servers — your own personal world.
### 🏡 Personal Realms
Every player receives a private Personal Realm — a fully customizable build world with preset biome options. Build your town, breeding hub, battle arena, or dream base without fear of griefing. Catch and Loot in the Wilds, Create and Build within your Realm.

It’s MMO progression without sacrificing creativity.

----------------------------------------
### ⚡ Server Features
- 🏡 Personal Realms (*private customizable worlds*)
- 🏆 Region-Based Gyms (*Kanto & expanding regions*)
- 🌲 Resetting Wilds for exploration & loot
- 💵 Player Run Economy
- 🧬 Breeding
- ✨ Catch Combos
- 💎 Mega Evolution
- 🌟 Legendary Pokémon
- 🎯 Hunts & Events
- 📖 Pokédex Rewards

Explore. Build. Battle.

Welcome to **MMO Realms** — the ultimate place to play Cobblemon. What are you waiting for?
